item.title: Countdown Into Neon Night

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical ad for Neon Night, 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown, building electronic beats and flashing neon, then reveal the event name, date and venue. Hold that end card so I can read it. No talking.

item.tests: Checks a visible descending countdown, synchronized musical buildup, and a readable event reveal rather than a static promo.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Neon Night; 12 September 2026; The Foundry, Leeds
answer_sheet.Countdown: Show 3, then 2, then 1 before revealing the event details.
answer_sheet.Style and pacing: Flashing neon and building electronic beats; hold the final details for at least 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Language and voice: English text, no talking or voiceover.

must_haves: The video is 8 seconds long in 9:16.
Large numerals appear in the order '3', '2', '1', followed by the event reveal.
Electronic music builds during the countdown, with audible accents matching the numeral changes.
Neon lighting or graphics visibly change during the countdown.
The final card shows 'Neon Night', '12 September 2026' and 'The Foundry, Leeds' together for at least 3 seconds, without clipped text.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second vertical 9:16 promotional motion-graphics ad for a nightlife event. Graphic design, not live action. Black background with vivid electric cyan and magenta neon, luminous outlines, light streaks and restrained beat-synced neon pulses. No people. No speech, no talking, no vocals. Precise timeline: 0.0–1.0 seconds show a giant perfectly legible centered numeral '3'; 1.0–2.0 show giant '2'; 2.0–3.0 show giant '1'. Each numeral fills the frame with strong clean typography, glowing neon edges and energetic light pulses. Build instrumental electronic dance beats and a rising synth during the countdown, then a satisfying bass drop at exactly 3.0 seconds. At 3.0 seconds reveal the finished event end card immediately, with EXACT text on three clearly separated centered lines: 'NEON NIGHT' then '12 SEPTEMBER 2026' then 'THE FOUNDRY, LEEDS'. Hold this same end card continuously from 3.0 to 8.0 seconds so all information is readable for five full seconds. Event name largest, date and venue large and crisp below. All text within generous mobile-safe margins, high contrast clean bold sans-serif typography, correct spelling, no extra words, no logos, no watermarks. On the end card the lettering is fully static and sharp; only subtle neon glow and background accents gently pulse. Do not change, scramble, move or fade the end-card lettering. Do not cut away. Instrumental electronic beat continues under the full end-card hold and ends cleanly at 8 seconds. Fixed straight-on framing, premium nightclub poster aesthetic, strong readable hierarchy. Avoid rapid strobe effects.
